about_the_game:
Blinkhead is a dark surreal psychological puzzle game where players must navigate through strange and dreamlike environments. Trapped inside shifting worlds, you must rely on logic, careful observation, and problem-solving skills to find a way out.

Each puzzle you overcome leads to a new surreal situation, unlocking further challenges that stand between you and freedom. The journey continues until you finally discover the truth—and achieve victory.

Features

  • Surreal Environments – Explore mysterious, dreamlike spaces filled with unusual structures and hidden meanings.

  • Logic-Based Puzzles – Solve challenging puzzles that require reasoning, observation, and creativity.

  • Progressive Challenges – Each puzzle unlocks a new situation with increasingly complex obstacles to overcome.

  • Atmospheric Experience – Immerse yourself in a dark and surreal atmosphere designed to keep you questioning reality.

  • A Path to Victory – Continue unlocking new stages until you finally escape and achieve success.

"Regret from never trying cuts deeper than failure itself. With that belief, you struggle to escape the dark path that lies before you. Every hallucination you face is a knot waiting to be untangled, every puzzle a reflection of the mind’s hidden scars. Each door you unlock is not just an escape, but a step closer to hope" — the journey of Blinkhead.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 @ 2.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 ti or AMD R9 380
